notes: Moxa IMC-101-M-SC is a DIN-rail-mount, unmanaged 10/100BaseT(X)-to-100BaseFX Ethernet media converter (metal housing, IP30, 53.6 x 135 x 105 mm) — desktop/DIN-rail form factor, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Only 3 physical ports total: one RJ45 Ethernet port, one multi-mode SC fiber port, and one DC power terminal block; no relay/alarm contact or console port on this base model. Fiber connector is genuinely SC (not LC); "fiber-lc" was used only because "sc" is not an available connector id in the schema — see port note. Power terminal block mapped to "euroblock-dc" as the closest schema id for a 2-pin DC terminal block (12-45 VDC, single non-redundant input). Ethernet port graded eth-100m since the interface is 10/100 Fast Ethernet only; fiber port left ungraded per instructions (no SDI/HDMI/DP/USB/RJ45 grade scale applies to fiber-lc). Source: official Moxa product page (fetched directly), cross-referenced against the Moxa IMC-101 series datasheet PDF filename found via search, though the PDF itself could not be text-parsed for confirmation.

ports.name: 100BaseFX (SC)
ports.note: Physical connector on the device is multi-mode SC (duplex), not LC — 'fiber-lc' used as the closest available id since 'sc' is not in the allowed connector list. Multi-mode 100BaseFX, ~4 km typical distance.

ports.name: Power Input
ports.note: 2-pin screw/terminal-block DC power input, 12-45 VDC, single (non-redundant) input on this model.
